_doc: CKG runtime predicate map (Stage E). Authoritative reasoning log = ../../doc/predicate-evidence.md s4. Each source IRI -> {action, ...}. Actions: type (record rdf:type lmckg:* via record_kind); label (keep rdfs:label); remap (-> wdt:target); remap_date (-> wdt:target, coerce xsd:date/gYear); remap_relation (-> wdt:target, rewrite/collapse object, type residue via entity_class); keep_relation (keep CTO IRI verbatim, rewrite/collapse object, type residue via entity_class); classifier_aat (P31 from record_types + keep AAT URI); classifier_media (P31 only); content_url; url_permalink (emit wdt:target only for Detmold -- currently UNUSED: NFDI_0001008 is self-referential in every feed so it is dropped, see its _note); is_about (type record, drop relation); drop. Absent predicate => drop (logged).

https://nfdi.fiz-karlsruhe.de/ontology/N._note: has url. Self-referential in EVERY observed feed (the object literal is byte-identical to the record's own subject IRI), incl. Detmold -- contradicting the original plan's expectation that Detmold's was an external permalink. So no P973 is emitted anywhere; the subject IRI already is the source permalink. The url_permalink action is retained in convert_to_rdf.py for a hypothetical future feed with a genuine external permalink.

https://nfdi4culture.de/ontology/CTO_000._note: has content url. In APSearch this literal sits on the schema:associatedMedia BLANK NODE, not the record, so the converter never reaches it via this remap (bnode subjects are skipped). preprocess.py joins record -> associatedMedia bnode -> CTO_0001021 and the converter emits <record> wdt:P953 <url> (URI node) post-loop. This remap is retained for a hypothetical feed with a record-level content URL; currently dead (musiconn/Detmold have 0).

http://schema.org/dateModified._note: metadata mod-date. In APSearch a single constant ('2025-11-21') across all records = CKG's harvest/processing date, not a per-record ELAR edit date -> CKG provenance, not source data -> drop.

https://nfdi.fiz-karlsruhe.de/ontology/N._note: has metadata standard. Constant CKG-ETL values (RDF / Schema.org) describing how CKG serialized its metadata, not ELAR content -> drop.

has metadata MEDIA TYPE = E3087 (application/json), constant on every record. Describes CKG's metadata serialization (the export is JSON), NOT the audio/image content type (there is no content-MIME field in the dump) -> CKG provenance -> drop.
dataset-level link (E6081 -> E6304, 1 triple); subject is the NFDI4Culture dataset entity, not a record. APSearch only -> drop.

http://schema.org/associatedMedia._note: record -> media bnode. The bnode itself is never emitted; preprocess.py uses this edge to join the bnode's CTO_0001021 content URL back to the record (-> wdt:P953). The associatedMedia triple is dropped here.
